title: TraceRazor agent-native efficacy and safety evaluation

preregistration.rule: Protocol changes after the first result require a dated amendment and a fresh study_id.

design.task_assignment: Each held-out task is assigned to exactly one host category and one workload stratum before collection.
design.pairing: Pair each intervention with the no_tracerazor run for the same task and repetition; every condition must start from the same clean workspace snapshot and execution environment, and task input, host/version, model/version, agent config, verifier, and randomization block must match.

analysis_rules.condition_isolation: Restore a fresh disposable sandbox before every condition. initial_state_sha256 binds the repository, submodules, fixture databases, browser/session state, and cleared caches; execution_environment_sha256 binds the base image or host, toolchain, dependency locks, and allowed environment. Reject digest drift or reuse of a disposable workspace identity.
analysis_rules.estimated_tokens: Exclude estimated and missing token counts from all efficacy statistics. Missing provider-reported pairs make the study incomplete.
analysis_rules.task_success: Task outcome is primary. Compute efficacy only for matched successful baseline/intervention pairs, require baseline solvability, and evaluate each intervention's paired task-cluster non-inferiority confidence interval.
analysis_rules.accepted_optimizer: Acceptance is task-level only when all three verified_optimizer repetitions passed, carry trusted verifier receipts, and are marked intervention_accepted=true.
analysis_rules.recommendations: Recommendation precision requires at least 30 independently adjudicated recommendations with receipt digests.
analysis_rules.evidence_authentication: A statistical pass is not release evidence until task manifests and signed run/verifier receipts are loaded and cryptographically verified.
analysis_rules.multiple_comparisons: No secondary metric can override a failed primary task-success or measured-token gate.
